name: animated-dialog
title: Animated Dialog
description: A window over the page that asks for a decision before you carry on.

changelog.summary: The trigger's hover fill no longer sticks after the dialog closes, and closing glides smoothly back into the trigger.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette, dialog included. Its primary colour fills the main button and the hover fill.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: rollingText
props.label: Rolling text
props.description: The trigger and button labels roll to a second copy on hover.

props.name: fillOnHover
props.label: Fill on hover
props.description: Buttons fill with colour from the edge on hover.

props.name: originFromTrigger
props.label: Origin from trigger
props.description: The dialog grows out of the button that opened it instead of the centre.

props.name: elastic
props.label: Elastic
props.description: The dialog springs in with a slight overshoot.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long the open animation takes, in seconds.

props.name: bounce
props.label: Bounce
props.description: How much the dialog overshoots and settles. 0 is no bounce.

props.name: fadeContent
props.label: Fade content
props.description: Fades the dialog contents in as it opens.

props.name: scaleContent
props.label: Scale content
props.description: Scales the dialog contents up with the dialog.

props.name: exitAnimation
props.label: Exit animation
props.description: How the dialog leaves: fades, drops down, or shrinks.

props.name: fadeContentOut
props.label: Fade content out
props.description: Fades the contents out when the dialog closes.

props.name: dismissible
props.label: Click outside closes
props.description: Clicking outside the dialog closes it. When off, the dialog shakes instead if Shake when blocked is on.

props.name: shakeOnBlock
props.label: Shake when blocked
props.description: The dialog shakes when you click outside and it can't close.

props.name: backdrop
props.label: Backdrop
props.description: What sits behind the dialog: nothing, a dim layer, or a blur.
